inputs.text: Listen, this so-called Liberal split is pure elite theater designed to bury the real issues and keep the public distracted. Angus Taylor has clearly been deployed to crush Andrew Hastie’s push for higher taxes on gas companies and rolling back concessions for property investors, all while they sell the story that it's just some philosophy clash with the opposition leader. That's the cover to protect the big interests still cashing in from those breaks. The opposition leader's refusal to back Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump, or even say whether he endorses the US and Israel’s war with Iran, isn't random silence—it's the hidden coordination at work to lock down the narrative and block any genuine pressure from building against the system.
